app.R29vZ2xlRG9jcw.short_desc.message: Connect with Google Docs to manage your documents

app.R29vZ2xlRG9jcw.desc.source: Integrate with Google Docs to create, update, and manage your documents. This integration allows you to perform actions and respond to events in your Google Docs account, enabling you to automate document management and collaboration workflows.
app.R29vZ2xlRG9jcw.desc.message: Integrate with Google Docs to create, update, and manage your documents. This integration allows you to perform actions and respond to events in your Google Docs account, enabling you to automate document management and collaboration workflows.

app.R29vZ2xlRG9jcw.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Make a custom API call to Google Docs

app.R29vZ2xlRG9jcw.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Google Docs** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
